_what: The four Etsy listings of the official dancing banana stream pack: what tools/etsy.mjs writes to Etsy (title, description, tags, price in NOK, photos and zip from tools/stream-pack/out/etsy/<folder>). Titles follow Etsy's 2025 guidance: under 15 words, 'Official Dancing Banana' first. 'ai' is the answer to Etsy's 'How is this digital content created?', which the API cannot set: set it in the listing editor.

full.title: Official Dancing Banana Twitch Stream Pack | 12 Animated Emotes, Sub Badges, Alerts, Scenes
full.description:
The official dancing banana, by Trym Stene, the artist who made it in 1999. Now for your stream.

INSTANT DOWNLOAD, one zip:
• 12 emotes (dance, hype, love, cool, lol, gg, rip, evil, gn, gm, vibe, shiny), each still and animated, in Twitch's 112, 56 and 28 px, plus 128 px for Discord
• 6 sub badges on bronze, silver and gold medals, for 1, 2, 3, 6, 9 and 12 months, at 72, 36 and 18 px
• 3 animated alerts (follow, subscribe, raid) and the classic dance on its own, on transparent backgrounds
• 3 scene screens, 1920 x 1080 (Starting soon, Be right back, Thanks for watching), each also as an empty stage, plus a full-screen overlay where the banana dances in the spotlight
• 6 panels: About me, Schedule, Discord, Support, Rules, Socials

Made for Twitch, Discord, YouTube and Kick. Animated emotes on Twitch need Affiliate or Partner.

Licence: for your own streams and channels. Please don't resell, share or use in a logo.

No AI image generators were used. The dancing banana is my own pixel art from 1999; a few small pixel pieces (hats and props) were drawn in code with AI's help, and I checked every one.
